wifi_share.name: Wi-Fi file share
wifi_share.desc: Shares a folder with devices in the same Wi-Fi, no app needed: open the link in a browser and download.
wifi_share.help: Starts a small web server on the phone. The address contains a random key, so only people with the link get in. Visitors see the files and download them. If you allow it, they can also upload files into the folder; existing files are never replaced. Access is limited to the shared folder. The server runs until you press Enter. Tip: with pkg install libqrencode a QR code is shown too.
wifi_share.hint: Open the address on a device in the same Wi-Fi. It does not work in guest Wi-Fi or over mobile data.
